issues.description: The Vietnamese question is understandable, but 'đã từng ... bao giờ chưa' feels a little redundant and wordy for A2.
issues.suggested_fix: Change to: 'Bạn đã từng đi phỏng vấn xin việc chưa?'

issues.description: 'Có, mình từng rồi' is a little abrupt, and 'Mình làm ở trường học' sounds slightly generic. Adding a verb and 'một' makes it more natural.
issues.suggested_fix: Change to: 'Có, mình từng đi phỏng vấn rồi. Mình làm ở một trường học.'

issues.description: The grammar note is clear but very short. For A2, it would help to show the position of 'ever' and 'never' with a short example.
issues.suggested_fix: Change to: 'Use ever in present perfect questions (Have you ever...?) and never after have/has (I have never...) to talk about life experience.'

issues.description: The hook is clear but not very catchy. It tells me the topic, but it does not make me curious.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the hook to: 'Anna has had job interviews, but Ben has never had one.'

qa_report.summary: This micro-dialogue is simple, clear, and suitable for A2. The target word 'interview' and review words 'work' and 'job' are easy to notice. The Vietnamese translation is mostly accurate, but a few lines could sound more natural. The grammar note would be more helpful with a short example or clearer word order.
